messages:
ana (PM): quick sync  we need contract-ready GA gates for routing + multi-region + tenant isolation. Sales wants something they can point at in early contracts. what are minimal acceptance items?
lucas (Eng-Arch): propose three customer-facing profiles: compliance (region-locked, audit trail), performance (edge affinity, low p95), economy (pooled, batched). each maps to placement, SLOs, and pricing model.
mohit (Infra): infra implications: compliance -> per-tenant placement + egress ACLs + audit sink; performance -> edge pools + sticky KV cache; economy -> global scheduler + quantized models. reserved SKU needed for compliance pilots.
tara (Sales): customers ask for: 1) deterministic p95 in contract; 2) a clear residency addendum; 3) a preview UI showing cost/latency delta. anchor leads: FinServCo and MediCloud. pilot length typically 60-90 days.
contracts-bot: reminder: include clause RESID-1 in pilot agreements and loop in legal early.
nana (PM): minimal GA checklist (short): a) automated residency enforcement tests passing, b) SLO verification (p95 + availability) measured end-to-end, c) two pilot cutovers with 14d stability, d) billing reconciliation within 5%, e) migration runbook (shadow -> cutover -> rollback).
lucas (Eng-Arch): SLO suggestions: performance p95 <= 120ms in-region, compliance p95 <= 220ms, economy p95 <= 350ms but target 30-50% lower token cost. GA availability >= 99.95 for paid profiles. fallback policy: auto-failover to regional pool unless tenant forced to stay.
mohit (Infra): test harness: multi-region traffic replay, tenant eviction/noisy-neighbor fuzz, billing tag reconciliation. rough ETA: compliance infra + logs = 4 sprints, performance path = 2 sprints, economy cost tuning = 3 sprints (parallelize where possible).
tara (Sales): need pilot pack: runbook, support SLA, pricing delta table. I'll secure 2 anchors if we commit to Q3 pilots. also require Console preview of profile cost delta in quote flow.
nana (PM): prioritization: 1) residency enforcement + audit logs, 2) Console policy editor + preview, 3) reserved SKU + pricing model, 4) cost-optimization for economy. gate GA on checklist above.
lucas (Eng-Arch): implement policy as tenant metadata + derived routing keys. quick policy sketch for Console/API: `{"profile":"compliance|performance|economy","region_pin":"<region|null>","fallback":"auto|manual"}`. store derived fields for fast hot-path lookup.
mohit (Infra): ops note: avoid parsing JSON on every request; use stored columns for routing decisions. will prototype placement enforcement and audit sink next week.
contracts-bot: task created: draft residency addendum -> @legal (due Mon).
nana (PM): action items: lucas -> spec + acceptance test matrix (EOW). mohit -> infra ETA + reserved SKU draft (Tue). tara -> lock 2 pilots + legal contacts (Mon). i'll assemble pilot pack and GA checklist.
tara (Sales): ack. pinging FinServCo and MediCloud now. :rocket:
lucas (Eng-Arch): one more: migration path must support incremental cutover: shadow traffic for 7-14d, mirror + metrics, DNS cutover with rollback plan. record cutover metrics: latency delta, error budget burn, and cost delta.
nana (PM): agree. GA gated on two pilots with stable metrics for 14d post-cutover. scheduling follow-up sync Fri 9am.
